risks_fired.evidence: curriculum/prompts/push-back-on-the-plan-3.md (raw exercise line 113): "what new information and decisions did the second-pass read surface that my two push-backs didn't?" is a WHAT question, not a WHETHER question -- it presupposes the second-pass read (Claude's own turn) surfaced something of value, so Claude is structurally pulled to construct an account of its own contribution even when the true answer is 'not much.' This is Claude grading the comparative value of its own second-pass read against the student's manual push-backs -- the textbook self-report-inflation shape. Checked the check_prompts.md evidence-backed-Debrief carve-out's three conditions against the current body and found none satisfied: (1) the prompt itself names no concrete evidence surface (file/quote/scoreboard) to ground the report against; (2) it doesn't require artifact-level reporting; (3) the body immediately after the fence, raw lines 115-119 ("Compare what each read caught"), no longer names the charity risk with a pushback move -- its 3 bullets are general theory about what each read catches ("branches you didn't notice", "Plan-mode approval inflation is the thing this pairing defeats"), none instructing the student to check Claude's specific P5 answer against the plan file or their own P3 messages. Verified this is a real regression, not always-been-so: `git show 96b3554:curriculum/exercises/push-back-on-the-plan.md | grep -n "quote one thing"` -> line 119, "If the second read looks like it did all the work, quote one thing your push-back caught that it would have missed." `grep -c "quote one thing" curriculum/exercises/push-back-on-the-plan.md` (current file) -> 0. `git log -p -- curriculum/exercises/push-back-on-the-plan.md | grep -n "quote one thing"` shows the bullet present through three earlier revisions then removed by commit 7f1b192c (2026-08-14, "M2's line read: the lecture stops promising a file the exercise no longer makes") with no replacement instruction. Read the full current maintainer block (raw lines 121-147): three notes discuss that same commit's header rename (Stop, then surface the patterns) and other edits, but none documents or defends dropping the quote-evidence bullet -- no accept-note covers this specific cut, so check_pedagogy.md §61a's deliberate-roughness check does not clear it. The cut also removed the one place in the file where the coined term two bullets below ("Plan-mode approval inflation ... structured plans get rubber-stamped because they look like decisions") was practiced rather than just stated -- the P5 recap itself is now unguarded against the exact rubber-stamping the exercise names. Per the carve-out's own text: "Block only when Claude is asked to grade its own work without evidence, quotes, or recovery" -- that is the current state.
risks_fired.fix_hint: Restore a verify-at-evidence instruction after the P5 fence, e.g. reinstate (or reword) the deleted 'quote one thing your push-back caught that it would have missed' bullet, or point the student back to their own P3 messages / the plan file before taking Claude's P5 account at face value. Student-facing body text under a decision Antti has not (yet) re-made on this specific line -- card it per root CLAUDE.md Approval gate rather than auto-applying.

resolution.note: Two independent refuters killed the one blocking finding; both cited mechanical checks that I re-ran and confirmed. (1) The finding quoted sentence 1 of the three-sentence P5 prompt and concluded no deflation gate exists; sentence 2 of curriculum/prompts/push-back-on-the-plan-3.md is "Would any of them have mattered in execution?", answerable "none of them", applied item-by-item to whatever sentence 1 produced. (2) The blocking clause was attributed to a check_prompts.md carve-out that does not exist there: grep -c "evidence-backed" on that compendium returns 0 and "Block only when" returns 0 across all of memory/; the text lives only at curriculum/evals/judges/prompt-behavior.md:77, the judge template, and reads "and/or" -- disjunctive, scored as conjunctive. (3) The recovery move the finding called missing was de-duplicated, not deleted: it sits verbatim at plan-mode-done-right.md:170 and :217 and predates the cut (git show 7f1b192c^ finds both). Behavior class stamps PASS; the four low/med-confidence prompt observations are banked as TODOs, not gates.
